dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped patterns with high-intensity jagged perimeters transitioning sharply to low-intensity interiors; one central 'O' and one right-lateral 'C' exhibit the highest edge contrast gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of discrete, non-gradient high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the left lateral flank and the dorsal-neck transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship formed by the centroids of the two largest dorsal annuli and a prominent high-intensity cluster on the left flank approximates a scalene triangle with a wide base.
